# ferentin_device_groups (Data Source)

List every device group in the tenant, sorted by name.

Every item carries `import_id`, the ID its resource's `import` block takes, and `managed_by`, who created it (`console`, `iac`, …). Filter on `managed_by = "console"` to find what Terraform does not manage yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every device group in the tenant, sorted by name.
data "ferentin_device_groups" "all" {}

# Groups created in the admin console, which Terraform does not manage yet.
output "console_groups" {
  value = { for g in data.ferentin_device_groups.all.groups : g.name => g.import_id if g.managed_by == "console" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant to list. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `external_id` (String) Identifier in the upstream system. Immutable on the resource.
- `group_id` (String)
- `import_id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<group_id>`, for an `import` block.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Who wrote it last. Divergence from `managed_by` means it changed hands.
- `managed_by` (String) Who created it: `console`, `iac`, `cli`, `system` or `unknown`. Never changes.
- `name` (String)
- `source` (String) `manual`, `scim`, `mdm`, … Immutable on the resource.
